primary_decoupling.activity_to_decouple: Arrange payment method and manage trust/safety risk (fraud concerns, identity confidence, payment security)
primary_decoupling.from_incumbent_bundle: Today this stage is effectively bundled into OLX’s classifieds matching flow but executed mostly off-platform by the buyer and seller via ad-hoc payment/trust arrangements, with OLX primarily supporting earlier matching steps (E7) while trust/payment remains a key pain point (E9).
primary_decoupling.customer_pain: Buyers and sellers must improvise how to pay and stay safe (identity uncertainty, fraud/scam risk, and insecure payment methods), adding time/effort and increasing perceived risk at the moment of closing the deal (E9), especially because the transaction/payment step is not consistently handled in-product (E7).
primary_decoupling.new_offering: Launch an optional “OLX Deal Protection” button inside chat that adds identity verification and automated risk flags plus a simple protected payment flow (e.g., funds held until confirmed handoff or a short acceptance window), monetized with a small transaction fee. This follows Teixeira’s decoupling logic of “separating value creating activities” to focus on one customer activity much better than incumbents (talks/first-lesson-taught-in-harvard-mba-in-18-minutes.md) while layering into the transaction stage where OLX can charge for value (E8).
primary_decoupling.why_customer_switches: Customers don’t have to change how they find items or negotiate—only add protection at checkout—so switching friction is low; they pay a modest fee in exchange for meaningfully reduced fraud risk and less coordination overhead at the most stressful step of the CVC (E7) (E8) (E9).

do_not_decouple.activity: Create and publish a listing (photos, description, price) to reach potential buyers
do_not_decouple.reason: This is part of OLX’s core digital value-creation loop (matching supply to demand) and should remain tightly integrated to preserve supply density and repeat posting behavior; pushing listing creation to an external/unbundled experience risks reducing listing volume/quality on OLX (E7).

do_not_decouple.activity: Get discovered by relevant buyers through search, browsing, and filtering
do_not_decouple.reason: Search & discovery is a primary value-creating activity that OLX already uses to deliver its core classifieds advantage (E7) and is explicitly a historical decoupling win from traditional classifieds (E11); unbundling it would weaken the marketplace’s central habit loop and traffic concentration.

do_not_decouple.activity: Communicate with interested buyers, answer questions, and negotiate terms
do_not_decouple.reason: In-app messaging/negotiation is a core value-creating step in OLX’s CVC solution (E7) and a key historical decoupling wedge (E12); unbundling it would fragment conversations, reduce successful matches, and erode the customer relationship.

do_not_decouple.activity: Coordinate delivery or local pickup/meet-up and finalize handoff
do_not_decouple.reason: This step is currently user-coordinated in the OLX model (E7) and is also a known pain point (E9); fully unbundling into first-party logistics would force OLX into heavy operational responsibility beyond the current classifieds scope, distracting from strengthening the trust/payment wedge first.
